function.name: confirm_booking
function.description: Only after the caller clearly says yes to the specific window you just offered (from the current proposal): decision=accepted with their actual words. Record declined if they say no. Silence, an unrelated yes, 'yes, but...' or a correction is not agreement. Never call it in the same turn as propose_booking. Success atomically books the appointment and assigns a technician (assigned does not mean en route). After an unconfirmed response call get_booking_status before retrying the SAME proposal; never create a duplicate.
